notes.title: Marketing Management - Units 1 to 5 Complete Guide
notes.subject: Marketing Management
notes.description: Covers STP framework, 7Ps of Services Marketing, Brand Equity Models, Digital Marketing channels, and real-world consumer behavior case studies.

notes.title: Financial Management - Capital Budgeting & Valuation
notes.subject: Financial Management
notes.description: Comprehensive formulas and solved problems on NPV, IRR, WACC, Capital Structure (Modigliani-Miller), and working capital forecasting.

notes.title: Human Resource Management & Organizational Behavior
notes.subject: Human Resource Management
notes.description: Talent acquisition strategies, 360-degree KPI evaluation, Herzberg dual-factor motivation theory, and organizational culture transformation frameworks.

notes.title: Operations & Supply Chain Management Handbook
notes.subject: Operations & Supply Chain
notes.description: Six Sigma DMAIC cycle, EOQ inventory models, Lean manufacturing, Aggregate planning, and global supply chain logistics case studies.

notes.title: Business Analytics & Predictive Modeling
notes.subject: Business Analytics
notes.description: Regression analysis, Decision Trees, Confusion Matrix, ROI optimization models, and PowerBI business dashboard design techniques.

notes.title: Strategic Management & Competitive Advantage
notes.subject: Strategic Management
notes.description: Porter’s Five Forces, Blue Ocean Strategy, BCG Growth-Share Matrix, Core Competencies analysis, and M&A corporate strategy.

notes.title: Principles of Management & Organization Dynamics
notes.subject: Principles of Management
notes.description: Covers core managerial functions (Planning, Organizing, Staffing, Leading, Controlling), Classical and Modern management theories, and organizational structures.

notes.title: Managerial Economics & Demand Forecasting
notes.subject: Managerial Economics
notes.description: Microeconomic foundations for business decision making: Elasticity of demand, Cost-Volume-Profit analysis, Oligopoly models, and Game Theory fundamentals.

notes.title: Accounting for Decision Making & Balance Sheet Analysis
notes.subject: Financial Accounting
notes.description: Financial statement preparation, GAAP vs IFRS accounting standards, Cash Flow statement modeling, liquidity & solvency ratio analysis.

notes.title: Corporate Finance, Mergers & Acquisitions Valuation
notes.subject: Financial Management
notes.description: Advanced financial valuation methodologies, Due Diligence checklists, Synergy calculation in M&A, Leveraged Buyouts (LBO), and hostile takeover defenses.

notes.title: Digital Marketing & Omni-Channel Strategy
notes.subject: Marketing Management
notes.description: Search engine marketing, conversion rate optimization, programmatic advertising, social commerce analytics, and mobile customer journey mapping.

notes.title: Global Supply Chain Logistics & Analytics
notes.subject: Operations & Supply Chain
notes.description: Container shipping economics, customs & tariff optimization, automated fulfillment centers, AI routing, and resilient supply chain architectures.

notes.title: Entrepreneurship & Venture Capital Financing
notes.subject: Entrepreneurship
notes.description: Incubation models, venture funding stages (Pre-seed to Series C), cap table modeling, term sheet negotiation, and IPO exit strategies.

notes.title: Corporate Governance & ESG Compliance Reporting
notes.subject: Business Ethics & ESG
notes.description: Board independence, audit committee oversight, sustainability reporting under BRSR and GRI, carbon accounting, and ethical leadership.

assignments.title: Marketing Strategy Case Study: Omnichannel Retail Launch
assignments.subject: Marketing Management
assignments.description: Analyze the retail expansion case study provided. Prepare a 5-page report detailing the STP strategy, promotional budget allocation, and digital acquisition channels for an Indian consumer brand.
assignments.submission_info: Submit written PDF report through college portal or email to r.nair@collegenotes.edu by 11:59 PM.

assignments.title: Corporate Valuation & DCF Financial Modeling Exercise
assignments.subject: Financial Management
assignments.description: Construct a 5-year discounted cash flow (DCF) model in Excel for the sample manufacturing company dataset. Calculate WACC, Terminal Value, and sensitivity analysis under varying growth rates.
assignments.submission_info: Submit working .xlsx file and a 2-page executive summary by October 20th.

assignments.title: Supply Chain Optimization & Warehouse Layout Simulation
assignments.subject: Operations & Supply Chain
assignments.description: Formulate an EOQ inventory policy considering holding costs and stockout penalties. Present layout recommendations to minimize picking transit time by 15%.
assignments.submission_info: Group submission (max 3 students per team). Submit hardcopy and softcopy.

assignments.title: HR Performance Appraisal Design & Retention Strategy
assignments.subject: Human Resource Management
assignments.description: Design a modernized 360-degree performance appraisal framework for a tech enterprise experiencing 22% attrition. Detail non-monetary incentives and mentorship programs.
assignments.submission_info: Submit via LMS before midnight of October 8th.

assignments.title: Financial Statement Analysis & Ratio Modeling Project
assignments.subject: Financial Accounting
assignments.description: Select an NSE/BSE listed company. Compute 3 years of liquidity, solvency, and profitability ratios. Draft a comparative performance review.
assignments.submission_info: Submit Excel workbook and PDF synthesis report via LMS.

assignments.title: Mergers & Acquisitions Valuation Report: Tech Conglomerate
assignments.subject: Financial Management
assignments.description: Conduct a comprehensive takeover valuation including synergy estimates, exchange ratio computation, and EPS accretion/dilution analysis.
assignments.submission_info: Submit report and supporting Excel valuation model.

assignments.title: Venture Capital Pitch Deck & Term Sheet Simulation
assignments.subject: Entrepreneurship
assignments.description: Develop a 12-slide investor pitch deck for an innovative business model with financial projections, unit economics, and required funding ask.
assignments.submission_info: Present deck in pitch room and submit PDF.
